test_title: SSC Selection Post HSC Level Official Paper (Held on: 11 Feb 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Study the given pie chart and answer the question that follows.

The pie chart shows the percentage-wise distribution of teachers who teach six different subjects.

Total number of teachers = 1600

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/083e7e4eaa6dca4ac1108937f5301118ea971513678171e04ff3b98d3e8261d5.png] 

If three-eighth of the teachers who teach Chemistry are females, then the number of male Chemistry teachers is what percentage of the total number of teachers who teach Biology?
solution:
**Calculation:**

Total number of Chemistry teachers = 1600 × (18/100)

⇒ 288

Number of female Chemistry teachers = 288 × (3/8)

⇒ 108

So, male Chemistry teacher = 288 - 108

⇒ 180

Total number of Biology teachers = 1600 × (15/100)

⇒ 240

Required % = (180/240) × 100

⇒ 75

**∴ Required answer is 75%.**
